title: How Do I Contribute?
text:
You can submit a Q&A by commenting in this post. That’s all you need to do.
If you can (you don’t need to do this but it would make my life easier), please format your submission in the recommended markdown formatting shown in the note below. You can checkout what markdown looks like using this site.






Note



##### Q. What does a nicely formatted question look like?

**Ans:**

This is what it looks like

<Anything else you want to add. It can be images, tables, whatever>
